author: Little Chinese Everywhere
description:
This city is home to massive factories and wholesale markets that export goods all over the world: from toys and stationery to clothing and accessories, you can literally find everything here.
Yet most people have never heard of it: Yiwu, in Zhejiang Province, China.
Despite being one of the world’s key hubs for international trade and exports, Yiwu has a very unique atmosphere compared to other Chinese cities. You’ll find a large international community, foreign restaurants, coffee shops, and a truly global vibe.
Join us in this episode as we explore China’s manufacturing capital 🇨🇳
